note: Bridger-Teton NF campground at the north end of Pacific Creek Road (FS 30090), about 10 miles from Moran, beside the Pacific Creek Trailhead into the Teton Wilderness; corrals, hitching posts and a stock tank for packers. Bear food storage required. --Claude
summary: FS page read (no rec.gov listing): 8 sites (7 + 1 pull-through), no water, double vault toilets, FCFS, $13 + $6 extra vehicle, open late May - early September (free after). Riverview kept (no site within ~60 m). Phone empty -> 307-543-3900. Horse-facility question flagged; no drop.
flags: CRITERIA (horse rule, AWH 2026-11-12/17): the FS lists 'corrals and hitching posts for horses, a stock tank' among the campground's amenities; it is the wilderness trailhead camp for the Thorofare. On imagery the stock pens and horse-trailer parking sit at the trailhead lot NW of the pin, ~150-200 m from the small camping loop NE of it - they look separate, and the FS sells the sites as ordinary single sites. Kept (stored curation_note already says 'general campground, not horse-only'); for the curator if the rule reads stricter.

WATERFRONT: riverview kept. The camping loop I can identify (~43.9407,-110.4411) is ~100-130 m from Pacific Creek through tree clusters; a meadow spur south of the pin ends ~60 m from the riverside trees. No site within 50 m over open ground. The stored waterfront_evidence places the pads 200-250 m across sage meadow - site locations are not published (FS gives no map, OSM unread), so the exact pads are unconfirmed.
